checked.original_verdict_or_edit: Append integral-salary sentence ('nothing is certified here for such an employee, including on termination') and 'WT 62117 is paid in the same month as WT 62110 ... not only in January'
checked.reason: 'current' identical to the final cell. Two statements in the appended text overstate the law: (1) CST art. 132 num. 4 requires the cesantias and prestaciones accrued up to the conversion to integral salary to be settled at that date, so an integral-salary employee CAN have 62110 / 62117 certified in casilla 47 in the conversion year - 'nothing is certified here for such an employee' is wrong as an absolute; (2) Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1 requires the interest on termination or WITHIN THE MONTH FOLLOWING a partial settlement, not necessarily 'in the same month' (same month is client practice). Correct verdict: Explanation to improve with this append instead: ' An employee on integral salary (WT 62140 Integral Salary) accrues no cesantias and no interest for the time on integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 2), so nothing is certified here for that time, including on termination; only cesantias and interest settled for the service before the conversion to integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 4) are certified here. The integral salary itself is certified in full in casilla 36. Interest on cesantias is paid with every direct payment of cesantias - WT 62117 on termination, or within the month following a partial settlement (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1) - and not only as the January interest of WT 62127.' Column L38 ('interest, paid directly each January') would then need the same correction - a second edit for Wallisson.
